small_guidance:
- The epilogue kernel is already memory-bound and fast; the remaining ~17ms is dominated by `nn.Conv3d`. Tuning BLOCK_SIZE/num_warps on the epilogue will not move fast_p meaningfully — focus elsewhere.
- If keeping the epilogue, try BLOCK_SIZE=2048 with num_warps=4 and broadcast the per-channel bias once per program (1 program per (N,C)) using a 2D tile over spatial to reduce launch count from N*C*ceil(spatial/BLOCK) toward N*C.
- Consider fusing `sum_tensor` into `conv.bias` at eval time (bias += sum_tensor.view(-1)) so the epilogue only does LeakyReLU→clamp→GELU; saves one add and one broadcast load.
large_guidance:
- Replace `nn.Conv3d` with a custom Triton im2col-style GEMM kernel: program tiles over (N, OC_tile, output-spatial tile), with K = IC*kD*kH*kW=216. Output spatial volume per sample is 14*62*62≈53816, OC=64 — a single fused conv+epilogue kernel will eliminate the separate cuDNN conv launch and the extra read/write of the conv output (≈216 MB).
- Fuse the entire epilogue (LeakyReLU + sum_tensor add + clamp + GELU) into the conv kernel's accumulator before store; absorb sum_tensor into the conv bias so only one per-OC scalar load is needed.
- Use channels-last-style indexing (contiguous over OC in the output tile) and hoist the (kd,kh,kw)→input-offset arithmetic out of the K-loop via precomputed per-K offset tables; autotune BLOCK_M (output-spatial) ∈ {32,64,128}, BLOCK_N (OC) ∈ {32,64}, BLOCK_K ∈ {32,64}, num_warps ∈ {4,8}, num_stages ∈ {2,3}.
